== Published English Original Virtual Set 2 wording ==
The early slip prints Going To and omits the exclamation point. The remaster prints Gonna and includes the exclamation point. The January 2003 Players Committee interpretation already describes the activation base for the turn using the opponent’s Force icons. Both versions retain the same Lost Interrupt action. The comparison records a printed title change and the different phrasing of the full text.
